home.title: Buy from shops across Sri Lanka
home.subtitle: Thousands of sellers, one cart. Pay with cash on delivery.

login.title: Log in
login.resent: If your account needs verifying, a new email is on its way.

register.title: Create your account
register.sellerNote: After verifying your email you can set up your shop. An admin must approve it before you can sell.
register.done: Account created! We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.

verify.title: Verify email
verify.success: Your email is verified. You can now log in.
verify.failed: This link is invalid or has expired. Log in to request a new one.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link has been sent. It expires in 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.success: Password changed. Please log in with your new password.
reset.missingToken: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.

account.title: My account
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been logged out.

comingSoon.body: This area is built in phase {phase}. Your access is working.

forbidden.title: Not allowed
forbidden.body: Your account does not have access to this page.

form.fallbackHint: Optional. Shoppers see the English text if this is empty.
form.imageHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB each. Up to {max}.

shopStatusHelp.pending: Your shop is waiting for admin approval. You can already add products as drafts.
shopStatusHelp.approved: Your shop is approved. Submit products for review to start selling.
shopStatusHelp.suspended: Your shop is suspended. Buyers cannot see your products. Contact support.
shopStatusHelp.rejected: Your shop was not approved. Update your shop settings to send it for review again.

shop.name: Shop name
shop.lowStockHint: Warn me when a variant has this many or fewer left.
shop.openIntro: Tell buyers about your shop. An admin will review it before you can sell.
shop.resubmitNote: Saving your changes sends your shop for review again.
shop.cashierMaxDiscountHint: The most a cashier can take off a POS bill in total. You have no limit.

product.name: Product name
product.weightHint: Packed weight. Used to calculate shipping.
product.variantsHelp: One row per size/colour you sell. A simple product needs just one row. Prices in rupees.
product.confirmDelete: Delete this product? Past orders will still show it.

statusHelp.draft: Only you can see this draft. Submit it for review when it is ready.
statusHelp.pending: An admin is reviewing this product.
statusHelp.approved: This product is live. Changing the name, photos, description or category sends it for review again.
statusHelp.rejected: This product was not approved. Fix it and submit again.

product.stockHelp: Online orders and POS sales use the same stock. Add (+) or remove (−) stock here.

store.staffCannotBuy: Staff accounts can't buy. Log in with a customer account to shop.
store.unavailableItem: This product is no longer available

cartProblem.UNAVAILABLE: No longer available. Please remove it.
cartProblem.NOT_ENOUGH_STOCK: Only {count} left. Please lower the quantity.

store.shippingAtCheckout: Delivery charges are added at checkout. Each shop ships separately.
store.fixProblems: Fix the items marked in red before checkout.
store.wishlistEmpty: You haven't saved any products yet.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.splitNote: Your items come from {count} shop(s). Each shop packs and delivers its part separately.
checkout.codHelp: Pay in cash when each parcel arrives.
checkout.agreeNote: By placing your order you agree to pay this amount in cash on delivery.
checkout.totalChanged: Prices or delivery fees changed. Please check the new total and place your order again.

orders.placedNote: Please keep {total} ready in cash. Each shop's parcel can arrive on a different day.
orders.cancelPrompt: Why are you cancelling? (the seller will see this)
orders.returnPrompt: Why are you returning this? (the seller will see this)

settings.freeShippingHint: Per shop. Leave empty for no free delivery. Shops can set their own amount.
settings.returnDaysHint: Seller earnings are released this many days after delivery.

shipping.ratesHelp: Price for the first kg and for each extra kg. Shops may set their own rates, which replace these.
shipping.usingFallback: No rates set yet, so every order uses {first} for the first kg and {extra} per extra kg.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.nothingToDo: No further steps for this order.
delivery.noteHint: Optional. Shown in the customer's timeline.
delivery.codPending: Cash on delivery not yet collected
delivery.codBreakdown: {transit} on the way ({transitCount}) · {delivered} delivered but not paid in ({deliveredCount})

track.title: Track your order
track.intro: Enter your order number and the phone number used for delivery. No login needed.

rider.photo: Photo of the parcel at the door
rider.proofHint: Take a photo or ask the customer to sign. At least one is needed.

adminDelivery.noRidersYet: No riders yet. Add one on the Users tab.
adminDelivery.noRiderData: No rider deliveries in this period.

sellerDashboard.noLowStock: Nothing is at or below {threshold} in stock.

earnings.howItWorks: You earn each order's total minus commission. It becomes available once the return period after delivery has passed.
earnings.minimum: Minimum payout: {amount}. All available money is paid in one transfer.
earnings.requested: Payout of {amount} requested. The admin will review it.
earnings.none: No earnings yet. They appear when orders are delivered.

staff.intro: Cashiers can log in to use your POS only. They can't see earnings, payouts or cost prices. A new cashier gets an email and must open the link in it before their first login.
staff.newPasswordPrompt: New password for this cashier (at least 8 characters):
staff.passwordChanged: Password changed. Tell the cashier their new password.

sellerShipping.freeHint: Orders from your shop at or above this amount ship free. Leave empty to use the site's amount.
sellerShipping.usingDefaults: You have no rates of your own, so the site's default rates are used.

pos.discountLimit: You can give up to {percent}% discount in total.
pos.holdPrompt: Name for this held bill (optional, e.g. 'Lady in red'):

pos.replaceBillConfirm: Replace the bill on screen with the held bill?
pos.pricesChanged: A price changed. The bill now shows the new prices; check with the customer and pay again.
pos.outOfStockWarning: {name} shows no stock. Check the shelf; the sale will be refused if none is left.
pos.cashDrawerHint: Your cash drawer should hold the cash total above, plus your opening float.
